previous_audits.verdict_rationale: The proof is an algebraic invariance and non-selection result over the cited fixed-density readout, not a positive physical identification. The D4 bridge is retained-grade via decoration-under-retained status, and the EW bridge is retained_bounded; the no-go uses their explicit boundary rather than importing an open selector as a premise. The runner mixes cross-note boundary checks with exact algebraic consistency checks and uses no external comparator. The N1-N8 no-go gate is present and the claim remains narrow: it blocks only reuse of fixed-density algebra alone, not future independent selector theorems.
